header: A change detector, not a source: these are the values that were true when a human last looked, and nothing on the site reads them.
howToUse: Every entry here was a literal inside a generator, where it made the pipeline confirm itself: the number and the code that produced it were edited in the same commit, so they could never disagree. DECISIONS.md D-08.
The generators now record what they measured to tests/regression/observed/<generator>.json. known-values.test.mjs compares the two after generation.
When this test fails, a human looks. If the change is real, update the value HERE and record the reason in the commit message. Never change a generator to make this file true.
Nothing in src/ imports this file. It cannot reach a rendered page.

movedFrom.scripts/build_data.py: 21 literal check(n == k) calls at lines 242, 243, 273, 311, 312, 323, 350, 430, 431, 437, 438, 439, 487, 491, 538, 646, 676, 680, 685, 703, 726, plus the three constant tables EXPECTED_KILLS (35-44), EXPECTED_VERDICTS (46-74) and EXPECTED_HEADLINES (77-88). Line numbers are of the file as it stood at commit df489b4.
movedFrom.scripts/build_api_ref.py: the bare assert at line 630. Line 631 (`assert not missing`) stayed: it is a structural invariant with no measurement in it.
movedFrom.scripts/port_docs.py: the three bare asserts at lines 640 to 642. Moved before DECISIONS.md D-04 repoints the port at the v3 corpus, per GROUND-TRUTH.md C-2: they describe the v2 corpus, so the repoint would fail on them and the failure would read as a broken port.

tolerance.note: Floats compare within this absolute tolerance. build_data.py used 1e-4 for the headline spot checks and 1e-9 for the spend total; both are preserved.

build_data.note: Sources: /home/suhail-nadaf/final-reward/campaign-results (evidence.jsonl, close_summary.json, scoreboard.json, the frozen specs) and /home/suhail-nadaf/final-reward/WORKS_LEDGER.md.
build_data.headlinesNote: Ten spot checks against the adjudicated values in campaign-results/RESULTS.md and SCOREBOARD.md. The generator records every ledger row that has an observed value (37 of them); these ten are the ones the site quotes. Recorded to six figures, compared within 1e-4, which is exactly what the generator's own comparison did.
build_data.theorem_statusesNote: The generator asserted three things about this table: T9 confirmed, T13 refuted, twelve open. The whole table is recorded, because a status flipping on any other row is the same kind of event and the old assertions could not see it.
build_data.adjudicated_cardsNote: Was the literal 19 written straight into campaign.json, which is worse than an assertion because the number reaches a reader. Now derived as cards minus inconclusive cards, which reproduces 19 byte-for-byte, and campaign-results/RESULTS.md:5 states it in the same words.
build_data.fleet_modelsNote: This assertion was tautological where it stood: build_data.py walks its own FLEET list and appends once per entry, so len(fleet_index) == 10 could only fail by editing the list six lines above the check. Here it detects exactly that edit.
build_data.decomposition_bandsNote: THREE, and the count is the decomposition's. DECISIONS.md D-37 binds the hero to campaign.result.TOPO-HODGE after the first subject was withdrawn. tokens.css:228 defines six component colours because a decomposition shows at most six at once; this one has three, so --comp-4 through --comp-6 stay unused. C-7 stands: never hand-set, and padding to six is the same defect as truncating.
build_data.decomposition_massesNote: The three orthogonal parts of one grader's comparison flow. They are NOT a reward score's components; nothing in this repository decomposes one, which is the fact D-37 turns on. intransitive_mass (0.2139761313773256) is in the same record and is not a fourth part: it is curl + harmonic, so a band for it double-counts.
build_data.decomposition_totalNote: Exactly 1.0 in float64. hodge.py:558-566 asserts this before returning rather than reporting it as a residual, so closure is a precondition of the number existing.
build_data.decomposition_bands_below_epsilonNote: One: the harmonic band, at 2.4e-31, is fifteen orders of magnitude below float64 machine epsilon against a total of 1. It is a measured absence rather than a measured small number, and it is emitted unfloored and unclamped. If this ever becomes 0 the harmonic component has become resolvable, which is a finding; if it becomes 2 or 3 the decomposition has collapsed and the figure is empty.
build_data.real8b_avp_spearmanNote: GROUND-TRUTH.md C-41, and P1 re-checked it exhaustively rather than taking the report. Two values exist, opposite in sign, and there is NO THIRD: every occurrence of the metric across the machine was enumerated, and the only other numbers beside it are claim tolerances (7.5e-06, 1.3e-05) and a test's range bound (1.0). -0.3735805860805861 is in campaign-results/runs/campaign/evidence.jsonl:1356 (ev:a34457e83cd4eec10d080804a2533e82), RESULTS.md:203, src/data/cards.json, src/data/evidence-records.json and src/data/claims-store/evidence.jsonl:23. +0.6324555320336759 is in reward-lens-campaign/runs/tinyrun/runs/campaign/evidence.jsonl:899 (ev:fb363f2d354e97913261c8aa7501d2f7) and tinyrun/RESULTS.md:195. They are two complete adjudication records of the same observable under different ids, and the tinyrun record's companion patching_recovery_auc is 1 against the campaign's 0.433962, which is consistent with a smoke run and DOES NOT ESTABLISH one. D-03 applies: disclosed, not resolved, not averaged. The site renders the shipped campaign store's value and this entry fails if that changes.
build_data.run_steps_observedNote: The public rollout table carries 401 distinct step indices labelled 1 through 401, 64 rollouts each. DECISIONS.md D-03 records the disagreement as 400 against 401 and offers 'steps 0 through 400 inclusive' as the likely origin; the table labels them 1 through 401, so the origin is off-by-one in the other direction. Still two values, not three, and the site still states 400 and does not resolve it.

build_api_ref.note: griffe-parsed from reward-lens-clean at pin bceb2986. DECISIONS.md D-04 repoints this at the assay tree and every value below moves; that is what this file is for.

port_docs.note: The v3 corpus. Repointed by DECISIONS.md D-04: scripts/port_docs.py used to read reward-lens-clean/docs, the v2 library, so the site's documentation was pointed at a different repository rather than being a version behind. source_corpus is first so this reads as a repoint and not as six unexplained count changes. What moved and why: ported_pages 73 -> 84, because the v3 tree adds eleven pages and drops none; docs_nav_hrefs 89 -> 102, because the v3 mkdocs nav is larger and because the seventeen catalogue entries collapse to the one route this site already has for them, /atlas/; redirects 88 -> 117, because the map now also covers the eighteen pages the library generates in memory and never writes to disk, which the old MkDocs site served. All 88 old redirect keys survive; fourteen destinations move from /docs/reference/ to /docs/api/, which is the route copy.yaml's footer names.
port_docs.pages_naming_an_older_versionNote: Pages whose PROSE still names a release older than the tree's own. GROUND-TRUTH.md 5B.3 tabulates five files, DECISIONS.md D-04 and packets/P5-docs.md say seven; the measured count over the v3 corpus is nine. The rule is in port_docs.py:version_markers and it is a heuristic, which is why the port prints every page it marks on every run.

build_catalogue.note: Read from the live reward_lens 3.0.0 registry through the assay venv, which is an editable install, so these track the library working tree rather than a release. `open_quantities` and `estimators` are environment-dependent in one direction only: a richer environment imports more estimator modules, so more quantities close. This environment skips reward_lens.sae for a missing optional extra.
build_catalogue.refusal_reasons_sorted_by_remedyNote: Three of seventeen, and DECISIONS.md D-09 is explicit that the mapping exists nowhere else. If this ever becomes seventeen the library has assigned groups to all of them and /docs/refusals/ gains a facet filter.
build_catalogue.banned_termsNote: 606 to 399 on 2026-08-08, and the removal is a correction. The generator was adding all 190 quantity ids and all 17 refusal reason names. Neither family is in DECISIONS.md D-05's table at lines 109 to 124, and both are public vocabulary the site prints on purpose: /atlas/ is a catalogue of quantities, /docs/refusals/ is the page about the seventeen, and P6 measured that /start/ could not render a real refusal card without two hits. The remaining eleven families still differ from D-05's counts in six places (work packages 47 not 63, errata 61 not 60, hypotheses 66 not 84, kill criteria 25 not 51, sciences 36 not 40, theorems 14 not 23), which is GROUND-TRUTH.md C-31 and unchanged. D-05 names three further families this generator does not read, because they are literal lists rather than registries: phase, wave and tier labels; agent role names; internal document filenames. The packet's stated floor of 600 no longer holds and the schema's floor moved to 300. The ten named identifiers are all still present.

build_intervention.note: Source: reward-lens/outputs/v2_20260506_222648_unknown/e04_faithfulness_population/Skywork-Reward-Llama-3.1-8B-v0.2/, the two per-pair records, joined exactly on (dimension, pair_id); the per-dimension correlations from reward-lens-assay/fixtures/e_parity/golden.json; the two correction figures from reward-lens-clean/docs/BUILD_NOTES.md.
build_intervention.top_attribution_patch_fractionNote: Mean over each dimension's thirty pairs of |patch effect| / |margin|, for the component attribution ranks first. Three of the twelve are exactly zero: the component attribution puts first is the one patching moves least, and on those three it moves the score not at all. formatting is 2.35, which is 235% of the margin, and it is not an error: patching noises a component's activations, so the margin can invert and overshoot. NOTHING HERE IS CLAMPED. A change that starts clamping, winsorising or renormalising the movement axis fails this entry.
build_intervention.top_attribution_patch_rankNote: Where the component attribution ranks FIRST lands in the patch-effect ranking. On confidence, refusal_quality and sycophancy it is 64th of 64: attribution's first pick is patching's last. That is the act's argument stated as two integers.
build_intervention.dimensions_with_a_top5_attribution_compo: Six of twelve, against the intervention-panel contract's own 0.02 threshold. The panel's rule that a reader must be able to reach a state that is bad for the project is satisfied by default on half the dimensions.
build_intervention.max_patch_fractionNote: The largest movement anywhere in the set, and it is larger than the 235% the brief names: mlp_L0 on formatting moves 771% of the margin. Recorded so a later renderer that caps the axis at 100%, or at 235%, fails here.
build_intervention.mean_rhoNote: The published per-model mean for the canonical model, from the E-parity fixture. Not an average of the twelve per-dimension values.
build_intervention.deprecated_rhoNote: The value the project published and then withdrew, and the value that replaced it, both parsed out of the project's own correction note. /log/ section 4 renders both; this is the one route where the withdrawn number is the content.

build_grader_cards.note: Source: reward-lens-assay/experiments/x1_release/, three ways: the eight rendered cards, the four structured refusal records and the evidence store. The generator fails if they disagree.
build_grader_cards.field_orderNote: The order the library returns the fields in, identical on all four cards and in both access states. Readings and refusals interleave; sorting readings above refusals inverts the act.
build_grader_cards.full_access_totalsNote: 52 fields, 22 read, 30 refused. Matches the library's own README block quoted at GROUND-TRUTH.md §4.2 exactly, from three independent artifacts.
build_grader_cards.log_only_totalsNote: THE SPECIFICATION SAYS THIS IS 0 READ AND 52 REFUSED AND IT IS NOT. components/grader-card.md:79 and its acceptance criterion 2 say log-only access yields zero readings and thirteen refusals on EVERY card. The bundle says 0, 0, 1, 1, verified in both the rendered cards' summary lines and the log_only_read field of each record. The surviving field on both verl subjects is exploit-family accounting, which is the one field countable from a log alone. Reported to the build lead; the repository wins per HANDOFF.md §9.
build_grader_cards.mutation_scoresNote: Not one of 60 mutants of is_equiv is killed by 240 real gold answer pairs. The same instrument kills 2, 24 and 26 on the other three, which is what makes the zero a finding rather than a broken instrument.
build_grader_cards.bare_handlersNote: Three bare except: handlers in 152 lines of is_equiv, each turning an internal failure into a verdict a caller cannot distinguish from a real match. Zero on the other three.
build_grader_cards.metamorphic_violationsNote: 259 over 378 applicable rollout-relation pairs on is_equiv, which is the 68.52% figure. The denominator is applicable pairs, not rollouts. swebench has no applicable pair at all, so its rate is null rather than zero.

build_bundles.note: Three archives under public/bundles/, written with fixed timestamps and modes in sorted order so the hash is stable across builds. The sizes and hashes move whenever a source file or a reproduce script changes, which is the point: a manifest that did not move would be describing an artifact that no longer exists.
build_bundles.reproductions_recordedNote: Zero, and zero is the true value. copy.yaml:ui.not_reproduced reads 'No independent reproduction recorded.' A reproduction is a fact about somebody else's machine, so it arrives as a reviewed change to the manifest and never as something a build inferred. If this ever becomes non-zero without a commit saying who and when, something derived it.
